runtime_resume_text: Preparation estimate: **5–20 minutes**, depending on external-drive speed and other jobs. Up to six local metadata workers; one numerical-library thread per worker. Allow roughly 6–8 GiB memory and at least 4 GiB free on the project drive plus 2 GiB on the Desktop drive. These are planning budgets, not measured benchmarks or OS limits. An input transfer should be on the order of tens to hundreds of MB; the script prints the actual output path and checksum.

**Download estimate:** roughly **12–30 hours** for 1.765 million IDs. At 30 games/second the estimate is 16.3 hours. Throttling, outages, validation, or a slow connection can extend this. Allow at least **8 GiB free** in the extracted package's drive, including space to create the return ZIP. No external XT_Pro drive is needed at home.
## API behavior and resume
- To stop, use Control-C. To resume, run the **same `RUN_HOME.command` in the same extracted folder**. Completed batches are hash-verified and not refetched. Do not extract a fresh copy to resume.

1. `CHOOSER_COMPARISON_HOME_RETURN_..._PRIVATE.zip` and sidecar: **transfer back to the data Mac**, not to chat. It contains the full inputs and completed raw/Parquet batches. Estimated packaging time 5–20 minutes, depending on disk speed and result size.

Rerunning import of the same archive verifies and reuses that directory. It never overwrites the certified validity run, Stage07 panel, A1, or IV pilot. Import estimate: 5–20 minutes. The downloaded metadata still needs to be reconciled with the original caches and attached to the analysis frame before estimating the ordinary-game placebo and active-resolution selection models.

The launcher requires all offline tests, including actual Parquet I/O, to pass before opening production inputs. Tests cover preparation and cache reuse, exact-case IDs, reordered ledgers, preserved orientation, corrupted manifests, partial responses, duplicate/unrequested returns, 429 handling, crash/resume, retrying only nonreturns, full-denominator reporting, archive traversal rejection, and private-return/import round trips.

A failed preparation preserves its partial output and can be rerun into a fresh transfer directory. Preparation is short and is not checkpoint-resumed. Home downloading is checkpoint-resumed. If metadata flags or nonreturns remain after three passes, send the aggregate report so a targeted repair can be scoped. Do not reset the run to refetch all games.
